sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of scurvy, with much weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of dropsy and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general soreness and tenderness of the body.
sections.Mouth: Gums swollen, bleeding, and sore. Tongue pale and flabby.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach.
sections.Abdomen: Distended and tender. Chronic diarrhoea of thin, watery stools.
